title: SIEPMU critical technology elements: provisional TRL self-assessment
assessor: Internal engineering self-assessment (Claude Code session on behalf of SYNTRIASS). Not an independent Technology Readiness Assessment.
evidenceRule: A level is supported only by executed results on the stated revision. Hosted CI run IDs are recorded in docs/engineering/CURRENT_STATE.md. No result is copied forward from another revision.

scale.source: Common nine-level TRL scale, software interpretation (paraphrased from the US DoD Technology Readiness Assessment Guidebook and NASA NPR 7123.1 software TRL definitions; not retrieved in this session).

levels.3: Analytical and experimental proof of concept of critical function; algorithms implemented and exercised on representative data.
levels.4: Component and/or breadboard validation in a laboratory environment; key components integrated and tested together with low-fidelity or synthetic inputs.
levels.5: Component validation in a relevant environment; realistic interfaces, data and conditions agreed with the sponsor; higher-fidelity integration.
levels.6: System/subsystem prototype demonstrated in a relevant environment, representative of the intended deployment.
levels.7: System prototype demonstration in an operational environment.

scale.relevantEnvironmentStatus: NOT DEFINED. The sponsor has not specified the relevant environment, interfaces, classification boundary, scale or acceptance criteria. No element can be placed at TRL 5 until those are agreed and an evaluation is run against them.

elements.name: Endpoint encryption
elements.implemented: Browser and Node endpoint E2EE: P-256 ECDH + HKDF-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM content and key wrap, signed context (schema v1/v2), encrypted local vault. Laboratory schema-v3 ML-KEM/ML-DSA path behind a closed-by-default gate.
elements.environment: Node 24.21.0 on Linux (local and GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04); Chromium (Playwright) for browser crypto.
elements.measuredResults: Native and browser interoperability tests pass; relay and authority stores contain no plaintext canaries in tested scopes; endpoint seal/open p50 ~15-17 ms for 16 KiB on the Trust Before Release host.
elements.failureConditions: Compromised endpoint or trusted key directory discloses plaintext; no forward secrecy claim; software keys.
limitations: Classical suite is not SAG graded
elements.nextMilestone: Sponsor-confirmed cryptographic suite and SAG route; integrate an approved provider through the provider port; independent cryptographic review of the composition.

elements.name: Identity and device security
elements.implemented: Password (scrypt) + RFC 6238 TOTP with replay floor; device enrolment with administrator approval; per-operation device proofs bound to request hash; session and device revocation; server-generated initial passwords.
elements.environment: Node 24.21.0; five-process TLS 1.3 / mTLS secure stack; Chromium.
elements.measuredResults: Wrong and replayed OTP refused (401); revoked device refused at next request (Demo 4).
elements.failureConditions: Stolen software device key plus credentials; no hardware attestation; prototype identity authority.
limitations: Identity proofing is an operator responsibility
elements.nextMilestone: Hardware-backed device keys (TPM/FIDO2) trial and sponsor identity/PKI interface definition.

elements.name: Dynamic authorization and release (policy-epoch-bound)
elements.implemented: Release of a wrapped key only inside one SQLite authority transaction that re-checks current user, device, role, duty role, unit/mission policy, grant expiry, global epoch, FLASH dual approval and crypto policy; signed hash-chained decision evidence in the same transaction; concealment after commit.
elements.environment: Node 24.21.0; separate-process race/crash tests; five-process secure stack; 10-zone Docker netem testbed (hosted).
elements.measuredResults: Both commit orders of revoke-vs-issue tested; revocation committed first blocks issuance; retry after restart returns the identical issuance (Demo 4); Trust Before Release 14/14 steps; testbed 75/75 exchanges under recorded netem profiles (hosted, 17fe1bf onward).
elements.failureConditions: Issuance committed before revocation cannot be recalled; single authority database (no HA); a malicious authority can sign false decisions.
limitations: Duty roles and FLASH dual control are provisional applicant policy
No formal proof of the invariant
elements.nextMilestone: Sponsor-agreed relevant-environment test (multi-host, representative network, agreed outage/revocation scenarios) with independent witness.

elements.name: Ciphertext relay
elements.implemented: Separate relay process storing ciphertext by digest with HMAC-authenticated, replay-protected requests over mTLS; no access to identity, keys or plaintext.
elements.environment: Node 24.21.0; secure stack; container job (three services) on hosted runner.
elements.measuredResults: Relay outage: submission refused with no half-written object; recovery on restart (Demo 4).
elements.failureConditions: Relay sees metadata and sizes; availability depends on a single relay; gateway readiness does not report relay health.
elements.nextMilestone: Multi-host deployment with relay health aggregation and storage-failure tests.

elements.name: Offline queue and reconnection
elements.implemented: Encrypted endpoint vault and outbox; objects sealed offline under a cached creation grant; on reconnection the authority re-checks current policy before any release.
elements.environment: Userspace fault proxy on the secure stack; real Chromium offline/reload; netem testbed.
elements.measuredResults: Revocation during disconnection holds the affected object with a signed decision while an eligible object is released (Trust Before Release steps 7-10); browser shell-upgrade offline start 3/3.
elements.failureConditions: An offline endpoint cannot learn of revocation until it reconnects; creation is not permission to deliver.
limitations: Fault proxy and netem, not radio/SATCOM/WAN
elements.nextMilestone: Sponsor-defined outage profiles on representative links with agreed queue durations.

elements.name: Evidence and audit custody
elements.implemented: Signed, hash-chained decision evidence; independent checkpoint custodian; recovery quarantine against rollback; detached verifiers in Node and Rust (differentially tested against 63 evidence and 16 canonical vectors and 400 seeded mutations).
elements.environment: Node 24.21.0; Rust 1.97.0; secure stack; hosted rust-native job.
elements.measuredResults: Tampered evidence rejected by both verifiers (Demos 3 and 4); Rust verifier 1.6-5.7x lower peak memory, 0.54-0.89x Node speed (measured on the Rust branch host, 4af847b).
elements.failureConditions: A malicious signer can sign false assertions; unanchored tail truncation is undetectable without an independently held checkpoint.
limitations: Custodian runs on the same host in the lab
elements.nextMilestone: Custodian on separately administered infrastructure; sponsor-agreed retention and audit access.

elements.name: Threat monitoring
elements.implemented: Rule-based alerts (AUTH_FAILURE, REQUEST_DENIED, ACCESS_DENIED with actor attribution, ADMISSION_HELD, RELEASE_DENIED, AUTHORITY_CHANGED); signed, redacted telemetry to an independent mTLS collector; operator acknowledgement.
elements.measuredResults: Demo 4: all four alert kinds reach the collector after policy changes; no content in telemetry; operator ack 200; non-operator read 403. Defect found and fixed in 0e8d1b9: telemetry stopped after the first epoch change.
elements.failureConditions: Detection limited to implemented rules; no behavioural analytics; collector is a lab sink.
elements.nextMilestone: Sponsor-defined detection use cases and SOC/SIEM interface; replay/flood simulations with measured detection latency.

elements.name: Existing-system integration
elements.implemented: Versioned adapter with mTLS-pinned source identity, strict schema, freshness, sender/destination scope, durable idempotency and capacity, status query; synthetic document-management emulator (Demo 3).
elements.environment: Secure stack; adapter as separate process.
elements.measuredResults: Demo 3 10/10: authorised document delivered with signed acknowledgement; duplicate, replay, unauthorised destination and unpinned source refused; no plaintext in adapter store or logs.
elements.failureConditions: Only the synthetic contract is supported; no real military interface specification is available.
limitations: No AFNET, e-Office or IAF C2 connectivity
Synthetic schema invented in the lab
elements.nextMilestone: Sponsor-supplied interface specification and test endpoint; adapter for that contract tested against a sponsor emulator.

elements.name: Crypto-provider agility
elements.implemented: Provider port and engine with suite policy, key lifecycle, fail-closed provider failure, no fallback; authority crypto-policy registry checked at submission and release; laboratory ML-KEM-768/1024, ML-DSA-65 and X-Wing providers isolated from release artefacts.
elements.measuredResults: NIST ML-KEM/ML-DSA vectors and X-Wing author vectors pass; downgrade and suite substitution rejected at authority and endpoint.
elements.failureConditions: No SAG-graded or Indian provider integrated; PQC composition unreviewed.
elements.nextMilestone: Integrate one independently qualified provider (vendor-supplied interface) behind the port; SAG route defined by sponsor.

elements.name: Secure sovereign deployment
elements.implemented: TLS 1.3 gateway, mTLS service identities with pins and CRLs, lab PKI with expiry/revocation, hardened containers (UID 1000, read-only root, dropped capabilities), 10-zone netem testbed, signed offline release bundles with rollback protection, operator-controlled roots.
elements.environment: Hosted container and testbed jobs (Docker on ubuntu-24.04); local secure stack.
elements.measuredResults: Container job: build, three-service run, in-container crypto/policy checks, image scan and SBOM pass; testbed 75/75.
elements.failureConditions: Docker host administrator is trusted; lab PKI only; no HA.
elements.nextMilestone: Multi-host deployment on operator-controlled hardware with real PKI and an authorised offline transfer procedure.

systemAssessment.statement: Integrated laboratory prototype: the full exchange workflow runs end to end across separate service processes with automated and scripted evidence on a pinned revision. Three elements (monitoring, existing-system integration, crypto-provider agility toward a graded provider) are at TRL 3 because their sponsor-relevant form is not yet implemented. Release, relay and offline queue are TRL 5 validation candidates once a relevant environment is defined; evidence custody additionally requires the D-T5-01 scaling fix (docs/trl5/PERFORMANCE_REPORT.md).

advancementTests.decision: TRL 4 validated laboratory prototype with completed TRL 5 advancement tests and outstanding gates
advancementTests.result: 33/33 PASS on an applicant-defined three-namespace environment (one kernel); not a sponsor-defined relevant environment; no independent witness
openGates: G4 hosted netem job green on candidate
